goal: Add a dispatch-only read-only workflow that runs a committed per-issue probe against production and uploads the shared-db-live-proof artifact --complete-outcome re-derives, so an outcome returning to shared-db (first case #2848) can complete.
dispatcher: Albert Hazan (owner, repository-maintenance authorization via orchestrator marker #2893)
prohibited_actions: No database write; the probe runs with read_only true.
No change to the lane script or its shared modules.
No hand-written ledger events and no retry of a read-back refusal.
Never delete a claim, lease, verdict, or coordination ref.
assumptions: Issue #2848 scope returns to u2giants/shared-db and its ledger is at live_verified; PR #2815 closes only #2848; production run 34871556647 carries production-migration-apply-56a51e24.
stop_conditions: Stop if completion would require editing the lane script.
Stop if the probe does not pass on production.
